blocks.raw:
<LawCallout code="ra9184" section="Section 37 - Audit">
Legal Basis: Presidential Decree 1445 (Government Auditing Code of the Philippines). The Commission on Audit has exclusive authority to examine all government-funded projects including architectural consulting contracts.
</LawCallout>

blocks.raw: <ExamTip>COA's three pillars: **Regularity** — were procedures followed (bidding per RA 9184, approvals obtained)? **Legality** — does the design comply with NBC, environmental laws, BP 344? **Economy** — was value achieved, costs controlled, waste avoided? Architects influence all three dimensions.</ExamTip>
